collectionPolicy.participantId: Use a random feedback ID; do not use an email address as the metric key.

metrics.definition: Distinct search sessions that open a package detail page divided by distinct search sessions with at least one result.
Detail sessions that copy an install command or initiate CLI installation divided by detail sessions.
Successful installs divided by install attempts, segmented by host, scope, and operating system.
New CLI users who complete at least one install divided by new CLI users.
Releases activated after validation and scanning divided by publication attempts.
Downloads whose artifact digest verification passes divided by downloads reaching verification.
metrics.action: Any lower weekly value requires an integrity incident review.

metrics.definition: Median latency for registry metadata requests, excluding artifact transfer.
Open known path-traversal, arbitrary-overwrite, token-exposure, or equivalent critical issues at beta review.
Maintained, manually reviewed starter skills available in the curated catalog.
Distinct external creators who publish successfully without maintainer intervention.
Successful installs completed by users outside the core project team.
Community-contributed or independently maintained adapters or validation rules accepted after review.
